name: ultra-goal
description: Interview an objective into a grounded goal, emit the runnable artifact, and gate the run on its anchor. On Kimi the Stop gate is tagged --host kimi because this host triggers a blocking Stop at most once per turn. UserPromptSubmit is the recovery channel: Kimi's reference makes every event but PreToolUse, Stop and UserPromptSubmit observation-only, so SessionStart is not registered here at all - a registration whose return value the host ignores would read as context recovery that cannot happen - and the injection other hosts get on session start arrives instead as one fixed-size line per prompt carrying the artifact pointer and the gate's last decision. TurnStarted is the turn boundary: it fires for every new turn whatever its origin (user, task, system_trigger) and carries turn_id, which a user prompt does not prove, so the continuation budget is scoped to the host turn through it. A declared degradation, not parity.

hooks.command: P="./skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py"; [ -f "./skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "./skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py" --host kimi; else exec python "./skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py" --host kimi; fi
